rationale: The short thesis has structurally degraded: price bottomed around $42.16 (MFE ~0.65%), reversed sharply, and the most recent candles show a clear staircase recovery back to $42.36–$42.42 with price now trading above the 9-EMA ($42.32), erasing the downward momentum signal that justified the entry. The take-profit at $41.65 is now roughly $0.71 away against an ATR of $0.06, making achievement within the session increasingly unlikely while the recovery trend risks turning the trade into a loss. Locking in the small remaining gain is the mechanical response to a thesis that is no longer intact.
